title: Pura Vida
meta_description: Pura Vida, close to Seacrest Beach, offers 3 BRs, private beach access, community pool, bikes, outdoor entertaining and peaceful coastal charm on 30A.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to Pura Vida. This lovely coastal home is located in the quiet and scenic Treetop Community, offering a peaceful setting surrounded by nature while still close to the beach, dining, and entertainment along 30A. Designed for relaxed coastal living without the crowds, this three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath home is ideal for a family getaway any time of year.

\*\*\* Attention: Due to the HOA rules and restrictions in this neighborhood, there will be an additional $250 fee to cover violations you may incur during your stay. If you do not incur any violations, your fee will be refunded within 30 days of your departure date.

ABOUT THE AREA: Treetop Community is a tucked-away neighborhood known for its natural surroundings, laid-back atmosphere, and quieter pace compared to busier 30A areas. Guests enjoy access to a community pool and designated beach access, making it easy to enjoy the coast while returning to a more tranquil setting at the end of the day.

BEACH ACCESS: Guests have access to private beach entry via Seacrest Beach, with wristbands provided in the home. Beach access is located at the entrance to Sunset Beach across from the large lifeguard stand on 30A. Limited parking is available; walking or car drop-off is recommended.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King Master with Ensuite Bathroom (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 2 -- Bunk Room -- 3 twin/twin beds with Ensuite Bathroom (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 3 -- King Bedroom with Ensuite (2nd Floor)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Community Pool
• 2 bikes included
• Outdoor Entertainment area
• Outdoor Shower
• Gas Grill -- Propane
• Washer/Dryer
• Self-Check in
• Coffee Maker -- Keurig Duo
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes, etc.
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods, trash bags, kitchen towels, hand soap, bar of soap for shower

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
